name: Oriakos
source:
Inspired by The Stanley Parable and Slay the Princess.

You play as Subject, a man trapped in an experiment. Explore the rooms around you, and seek a way out.

[From [url=https://egosuit.itch.io/oriakos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灵感来自《史丹利寓言》和《杀死公主》。

你扮演受试者，一个被困在实验中的人。探索你周围的房间，并寻找出路。

[来自[url=https://egosuit.itch.io/oriakos]Itch.io[/url]]
